name: Grasping Limbs (3-4)

stealth.note: (trained); DC 20 Perception check (trained) to notice the construct limbs at the bottom of the pit.

description: The limbs of smashed constructs line the bottom of the fissure, beneath the water. They desperately grab anything that gets too close.
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) or Engineering Lore or Azlant Lore twice to immobilize the limbs, or Deception twice to trick the limbs into grasping each other.
routine: (2 actions) The grasping limbs try to Grapple all creatures in the water (Athletics +9). They then tighten around all creatures they have grabbed or restrained, dealing 1d8 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Grasp
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature falls into the water

Effect The smashed constructs at the bottom of the water try to Grapple the triggering creature (Athletics +9). The trap rolls initiative.
